correctness.rationale: Explicit orthogonal H1 energy split into zero-sum vertex affine functions and Dirichlet edge remainders. L+ diagonal invariance and elementary Dirichlet Green integrals give the exact Q(e,t); trace LL+=N−1 gives Foster average and strict positivity for degree≥3. Complete equality follows from unique t(1−t) peak and Hilbert Cauchy–Schwarz. Hypercube spectrum gives rational formula; exact recurrence and A_n>1/n for n≥4 prove strict monotonicity, while small n determine the unique dimension-four maximum. The continuum Poisson finite-element check independently reproduced 565 rational evaluation identities. Experiments are not the proof; all hypotheses and boundary degrees are addressed.

value.rationale: A natural sharp functional invariant (H1 energy to C(G)) for every vertex-transitive equilateral metric graph is reduced to two standard, independently meaningful electrical invariants. The least-resistance edge-orbit principle unexpectedly discriminates different edge orbits even with full vertex symmetry; an explicit C7(1,2) witness has exact positive orbit gap 1/182. Exact hypercube sharp constants exhibit a unique dimension-four maximum, strict subsequent decline, and a limiting quarter law, answering a natural dimension-comparison question. These are structural classifications across unbounded graph families, not mere finite table entries.
